meta.source: Placeholder tokens. Replace every value with the brand of the new film (logo, site, app theme) during the brief.
meta.canvas: Film 9:16 at 1080x1920 px, 30 fps. All px values are at that size.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on the light ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and hit words on light scenes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand fill: accents, floods, charts. Not for small text.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Rare highlight, max 1-2 times per scene.

gradients.name: gradient-deep
gradients.usage: Dark scenes (hook, drop, CTA). Never two dark scenes in a row except inside a flood.

styles.name: hit-word
styles.usage: Fast beat hits: one or two words that slam in on a beat.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The slow-beat message line of each section, max ~6 words per line.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: Reels / TikTok / WA Story top UI. Text and cards stay below.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Platform caption and buttons area. Text and cards stay above.

motion.note: Consumed by src/theme.ts and src/lib/motion.ts. Every layer is a pure function of time; no CSS transitions, no random without a seeded PRNG.

tokens.name: spring-punch
tokens.usage: Fast hits in hype scenes: slight overshoot.

tokens.name: whip-pan
tokens.usage: Camera slams sideways with motion blur, lands with a small overshoot.

tokens.name: zoom-through
tokens.usage: Camera dives into an element; the element becomes the next scene.

tokens.name: camera-punch
tokens.usage: Beat pulse on the camera container.

tokens.name: word-stagger
tokens.usage: Masked rise per word with a small rotation.
